verdict.rationale: LanceDB's own docs say quantization compresses and stores vector indexes, and they name three techniques: PQ, RaBitQ, and SQ. That directly covers enabling compression to cut storage and memory. However, the evidence pack contains no documented accuracy/recall trade-off or concrete memory/storage savings figures. The exhaustive flat-scan option for ground truth is only adjacent. missing for 10: documented accuracy/recall trade-off per quantization method, quantified memory/storage savings, configuration examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can enable vector quantization or compression to cut memory and storage cost with a documented accuracy trade-off

citations.quote: Quantization is used in LanceDB to efficiently compress and store vector indexes.
LanceDB provides $3$ distinct quantization techniques: Product Quantization (PQ), RaBitQ Quantization (RQ), and Scalar Quantization (SQ).
